environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running legacy monolith in us-east-1 VPC. Application deployed as systemd service with Python 3.8. pgBouncer running on localhost:6432 in transaction pooling mode connecting to RDS PostgreSQL 13. LDAP server is Active Directory on Windows Server 2019 at ldap.internal.corp:389 (unencrypted). Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from ALB. No WAF attached to ALB. Instance has IMDSv1 enabled. Application runs as ec2-user with no AppArmor/SELinux enforcement.
